exposure: home monitoring of fetal heart rate
outcome: reliability of home monitoring of fetal heart rate
clinical signs of Neonatal Lupus in newborns
cohort: Pregnant women positive for anti-Ro/SSA autoantibodies, recruited from 11 Italian centers, and their newborns.
finding: The study aims to evaluate the reliability of home monitoring of fetal heart rate, establish the incidence of fetal AVB in anti-Ro/SSA positive pregnant women, and assess if early treatment can influence the disease course.
gest_age: Fetal heart rate monitoring is performed between 16 and 34 weeks of gestation; AVB commonly develops between 16 and 26 weeks of gestation.
